name: firefly-koinon
description: Connect your desktop assistant to authorized knowledge in firefly koinon.
long_description: Discover authorized knowledge through your organization's firefly koinon MCP endpoint. Use an operator-registered public OAuth client and explicit browser sign-in. OAuth credentials stay in memory for this desktop session only; reconnect after restart or expiry. Personal access tokens remain an explicit compatibility mode. Server permissions govern every operation.

server_url.title: MCP endpoint
server_url.description: Your operator's full HTTPS MCP URL, for example https://knowledge.example.com/mcp. No credentials or query parameters.

auth_mode.title: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: Use oauth for browser sign-in (recommended), or pat for explicit personal-token compatibility. Leave the token field empty in OAuth mode.

oauth_client_id.title: Public OAuth client ID
oauth_client_id.description: The public client ID registered by your operator. This is not a secret. Required in OAuth mode; no automatic client registration is performed.

oauth_callback_port.title: OAuth callback port
oauth_callback_port.description: Must match your operator's exact registered callback: http://127.0.0.1:42839/oauth/callback for the default port. Local sign-in uses this port temporarily.

token.title: Personal access token (pat mode only)
token.description: Leave empty for OAuth. In pat mode, use a scoped koinon personal access token. Sent only to the configured MCP endpoint.
